CVE-2026-138160.title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulner ...
CVE-2026-138160.description: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ReadBackupTextLen() that allows attackers to overwrite stack memory via crafted backup files. Attackers can supply overlong quoted text values decoded into a 10,000-byte stack array during convertbackup, restore, or GSM_ReadBackupFile calls, causing crashes or potential code execution.

CVE-2026-138161.title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in L ...
CVE-2026-138161.description: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in LoadBackup() that allows attackers to corrupt memory by supplying an overlong MD5 value in a crafted backup file. Attackers can overwrite adjacent phonebook and calendar entry pointers via strcpy() into MD5Original when files are loaded with convertbackup or restore, causing crashes or potential code execution.

CVE-2026-138162.title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulner ...
CVE-2026-138162.description: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ALCATEL_EncodeString() that allows attackers to overwrite stack memory via oversized encoded phonebook text. Attackers can supply a crafted backup restored with gammu restore or addnew to an attached Alcatel phone, using GSM extension characters to crash Gammu or potentially execute code.

CVE-2026-138163.title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in Read ...
CVE-2026-138163.description: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in ReadWAPSettingsEntry() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted backup files with excess WAP or MMS settings entries. Attackers can supply a backup with more than four TitleNN keys in a [WAPSettings] or [MMSSettings] section, loaded via convertbackup, restore, or GSM_ReadBackupFile, causing crashes or potential code execution.

CVE-2026-138164.title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulner ...
CVE-2026-138164.description: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in SaveBackupText() in backtext.c that allows attackers to corrupt stack memory by supplying long text fields. Attackers can craft a backup with long calendar or note fields that, when converted with gammu convertbackup, writes hex digits past the 10,000-byte stack buffer.
